query:
WITH charge AS (
    DELETE FROM pending_gateway_charge
    WHERE
        account_id = $1
        AND operation_key = $2
    RETURNING
        inner_spend
)
UPDATE
    account
SET
    allowance = greatest(
        allowance - (
            $3 + CASE
                WHEN $4 THEN (SELECT inner_spend FROM charge)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ),
        0
    )
WHERE
    account_id = $1
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM charge)
